featured.label: Hiring Now
featured.title: CEO Assistant
featured.text: Work directly with the CEO of our investment group. Portfolio coordination, document preparation, calendar management, and communication with partners across companies.

openPositions.label: Open Positions
openPositions.title: We are looking for team members
openPositions.description: We are currently looking for sales representatives and project managers for our portfolio companies. We offer work in a dynamic environment with real impact on company growth.

salesRep.title: Sales Representative
salesRep.description: We are looking for experienced sales representatives for our portfolio companies. You will be responsible for acquiring new clients, building business relationships, and achieving sales targets.
requirements: Experience in B2B or B2C sales

projectManager.title: Project Manager
projectManager.description: For our growing portfolio, we are looking for project managers to lead key projects across industries — from construction and energy to hospitality.
requirements: Ability to work with multiple teams simultaneously
Knowledge of project management methodologies (a plus)

cta.heading: Interested in a position?
